answer: The delta explorer reveals the whole merge tree. Splitting into 6 separate vaults presupposes a separate funded nebula account and a separate escrow deposit for each, thus the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence because the lotus binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. A 79 account operation therefore ties up 19 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
